title: Cesura Core
description: Cesura Core Mod for the Official Cesura Server
body:
✨ Welcome to the official **Cesura Core** mod — the required client mod for the **Cesura** Cobblemon server.

🌍 Cesura is a long-term Cobblemon RPG experience featuring three handcrafted regions, a fair no-P2W ELO-based league system, and custom mechanics like dynamic Hoopa Ring legendary encounters.

## What this mod adds

- A custom server banner on the Multiplayer screen with live status, player count, and ping — one click connects you directly to Cesura
- Inventory shortcut buttons for the server's Backpack, Gym Badges, Ranked Ladder, Quests, Missions, Fly Map, and Cosmetics screens
- In-game UI for quest dialogs, the quest log, and an on-screen quest tracker HUD
- Cosmetic features: nameplate frames and a battle music system with playlist / radio mode, volume control, and auto-pause during fights
- Client-side rendering for the server's Pokemon Egg items, used by the daycare and breeding system

🛑 This mod is built exclusively for the Cesura server and has no functionality in singleplayer or on other servers. If you connect to Cesura without this mod installed, you'll be kicked with a message asking you to install it (the server's custom UIs and features simply can't work without it — you literally can't play on Cesura without this mod).

🎮 Ready to challenge Gym Leaders, explore unique regions, and start your own journey? Connect to **playcesura.com** and join the adventure! 🚀
